title: Mage Thunderbolt Staff Build
lede: An Elemental Staff build from level 1 to endgame. You level on the fire path, which is the only Mage build tagged for solo leveling, then respec into RaidDex's lightning Thunderbolt build for endgame. The Wavesword is your emergency weapon.

notice.title: Built from Wikily's node lists. Not tested in-game.
notice.text: Both trees use Wikily's nodes and requirements with an approximate layout. Costs follow the in-game markers: "3" nodes cost 3, all others 1, and granted skills (✓) are free. Where branches split and rejoin you take one side, and the other turns red [me]. Both plans spend exactly 94 points. A screenshot of your Staff and Wavesword trait screens would let me match the layouts.

stages.name: Leveling
stages.goal: Level with fire. Wall of Fire and Flaming Blossom clear packs, and Retain chains spells together.
weapons: Elemental Staff as your main weapon [ok]
skills: Flaming Blossom, Wall of Fire and Arcane Fount do your damage [one]
Retain recasts spells instantly and builds Energy Cores [ok]
Shooting Star becomes available at 10 Energy Cores [ok]
XLGAMES cut Wall of Fire's damage for launch [one]
traits: Diamond Shores has 11 Coilstones = 22 points: 19 on the Staff (Retain → Wall of Fire → Arcane Fount → Overload) and 3 on the Wavesword for a faster Ice Crystal shield with damage reduction [me]
Most Staff spells and Ice Crystal are granted free [ok]
gear: At Lv 40, RaidDex's spread is 64 INT / 50 CON [one]
check: Put Staff and Wavesword on Q swap
Unlock Retain and Wall of Fire
Pick up every Raeven's Coilstone you pass
Reach Shooting Star in the fire path

stages.name: Gearing
stages.goal: Get your midgame staff, then respec traits from fire to the lightning path.
weapons: XLGAMES corrected its Temper stats on Nov 10, so check current numbers before you temper it [ok]
skills: Elemental Overload: block during a Lv. 1–2 cast to cast the next tier instantly [one]
Lightning Pillar → Lightning Surge → Bolt Sequence [one]
Elemental Celerity makes you stagger-immune while casting incantations [one]
traits: Gylden Ruins has 14 Coilstones = +28, for 50 total: Shooting Star, Elemental Celerity, Untouchable Veil, and the Wavesword Freeze line [me]
Switching to Thunderbolt means a trait reset, and the cost is unknown [me]
gear: Light armor gives a 25% SP cost reduction, per one creator [one]

stages.name: Endgame
stages.goal: Lightning burst from range, with Shooting Star on demand and Ice Crystal as your emergency shield.
skills: Full rotation in the section below [one]
Ice Crystal (Wavesword): a shield that scales with Max HP, held on R [one]
Arcane Fount fully restores SP on Burn or Shock, once every 5 s [ok]
traits: Astron Plains has 22 Coilstones = +44, for 94. The Staff finishes at 48, the Wavesword at 36, and the last 10 buy the Staff's Damage ↑ at HP ≥70% node (Wikily's cost) [me]
gear: Put everything else into INT, with some CON as a buffer [one]
check: Cast Shooting Star at 10 Energy Cores in a boss fight

rotation.title: Thunderbolt rotation
rotation.intro: RaidDex's Thunderbolt chain [one]. Shooting Star goes on {R} once you have 10 Energy Cores.

steps.d: Three Ignitions give you about 20 s of higher crit rate.
With Lightning Speed, a Heavy Attack casts it instantly.

steps.t: Retain it with Dual Resonance, then recast
steps.d: Recasting a retained spell builds Energy Cores.
Lightning Surge follows the retained Pillar. Lightning Bolt on a Shocked target grants Bolt Sequence.
Block during the charge. Overload - Lightning Spear homes in, so you don't need to aim.
A large area strike that knocks enemies down.

rotation.after: Arcane Fount refills your SP whenever you Shock a target (once every 5 s). If something lands on you, swap to the Wavesword with {Q} and hold {R} for Ice Crystal.

disputes: Nerd Bird calls it weak because casts get interrupted during ramp-up. AOEAH rates it 9/10 for PvE.
The Thunderbolt path takes Elemental Celerity for stagger immunity while casting [me].
XLGAMES cut its damage for launch. Hey Jensen still calls it "completely busted".
The fire leveling path still uses it. Endgame switches to lightning.
RaidDex: mostly INT plus CON. Kybuza: about 2:1:1 INT / AGI / Talent. FrozenCloud: 2 stamina for each INT. AAC Tools' demo values per point: END +6.6 SP and +4.2 defense, CON +7.2 HP.
INT first, Endurance second (Blink and Overloaded casts cost a lot of SP), CON third, Talent 33 [me].
Most guides say 92. RaidDex's Frost Moon page says 112. RaidDex's Coilstone list: 47 × 2 = 94.

trees.intro: All 59 Elemental Staff nodes from Wikily. The layout is approximate [me]. Costs follow the in-game markers: "3" nodes cost 3, all others 1, and granted skills (✓) are free. Where branches split and rejoin you take one side, and the other turns red [me]. Three forks decide fire or lightning: Wall of Fire or Lightning Storm, the Flamethrower or Lightning Spear overload, and the Blossom or Pillar line. Full tree with choices made: 48 points, plus a stat cluster.

treeHelp: Click a node to read it. Double-click it, or press Space, to unlock or refund it. ✓ = granted free. Red = locked because you took the other side of that fork. Fill with my points follows the leveling plan across both weapons until your points run out. Saved in this browser.
budgetIntro: Early Access has 47 Raeven's Coilstones at 2 trait points each, 94 in total [one]. Region counts are RaidDex's [one] and level bands are archeagechroniclesdata's [one]. You only reach these totals if you take every Coilstone as you go. Both weapons spend from the same pool.

weaponGuide.intro: Every Mage starts with the Elemental Staff, the class's default weapon [ok]. Put your first points there. It's the only Mage build tagged for solo leveling, and most of its spells are already free.

pros: Ranged area damage. AOEAH rates it 9/10 PvE, 9.5/10 PvP [ok]
Most spells are granted free, so points go into upgrades [ok]
Arcane Fount refills SP when you Burn or Shock [ok]
cons: Fragile, and casts get interrupted during ramp-up in solo boss fights [ok]
Wall of Fire was nerfed for launch [one]
items.skip: A Wavesword-only Mage is a melee caster with B-tier PvE ratings. It's harder to level, and you lose ranged area damage.

pros: Ice Crystal (free) is an emergency shield that scales with Max HP [ok]
items.skip: You have no shield when a boss closes in. With only the Staff, Untouchable Veil and Blink are your only defenses.

plans.name: Fire, with early Ice Crystal defense (recommended for leveling)
route: Retain → Wall of Fire → Elemental Overload, then 3 Wavesword points (Frost Shard, Swift Bloom, Fortification). Those make your free Ice Crystal shield faster and add damage reduction. Then down the Staff to Arcane Fount and the Overload line [me].
Shooting Star, Elemental Celerity (no more interrupted casts) and Untouchable Veil, plus the Wavesword's Freeze line to Glacial Burst [me].
Thundersnow and Nebe's Might on the Wavesword, Staff capstones, the Lunar Eclipse line, and the 10-point stat node last [me].
steps: Damage reduction after an Ice Crystal block
SP refill on Burn or Shock
Last: unconfirmed whether it helps the Wavesword

carry.intro: Each weapon has its own tree, but both spend from one shared point pool [ok]. Below, I sort every effect by what its node text actually says. Ends on swap means the text says so. Only that weapon covers nodes that change that weapon's own skills or say "equipped weapon". Unconfirmed means the text doesn't say either way, so I'm not guessing. One creator video reports a global cooldown when you swap mid-combo [one].

cols.label: Ends on swap (node text says so)
items: Ice Crystal (Wavesword): one guide says swapping removes it immediately [one]

cols.label: Only that weapon
items: Skill upgrades only change that weapon's own skills: Retain, Overloads, Frost Shard upgrades, and so on [ok]
Staff stat cluster: Weapon Physical / Magic ATK ↑ say "weapon ATK". The plan skips them [ok]

cols.label: Unconfirmed: test before relying on it
items: Fortification's 15 s damage reduction after an Ice Crystal block: does it stay when you swap back to the Staff? [me]
Stat nodes: Staff Magic Amplification +50 and Fire ATK +20, Wavesword Tidal ATK +20 and Magic Amplification +25 [me]
Damage ↑ at HP ≥70% (+2.5% damage) doesn't say "weapon". The plan buys it last for that reason [me]

test: Stat nodes: open the Character screen with the weapon whose tree has the node (for example, Warhammer for its Fire ATK +20) and note the value. Press {Q}, then reopen the screen. If the number didn't change, the node counts for both weapons.
Shields and buffs: start the effect (a shield or timed buff), press {Q} right away, and watch the buff bar or shield. If the icon stays, it carries over.
Tell me what you see and I'll update the page. Until then, those rows stay marked as unconfirmed.
